policy.numeric_order: Canonical source records and native SLOp enum must match exactly by name and position.
policy.compatibility: Existing opcode IDs 0-194 are frozen; all additions are append-only.
policy.family_ranges: Reserved ranges are inclusive and may only be allocated to their named family.
policy.reservations: Reserved IDs are not executable enum/source entries and must fail closed.
policy.placeholders: Do not add placeholder enum entries or source records for reserved IDs.
policy.operand_contracts: Legacy operand contracts are not yet normalized in this catalog; consult the referenced native declaration. New opcodes must add an explicit machine-readable operand contract before activation.

operand_contract.description: Operand a is stable SLMATHFunction ID; stack is fallback marker, helper-name String, then numeric arguments.
